artifacts.summary: 10-phase lean4 hard-mode plan landing B1, B2a, B3a, B3b (closure alphabet, trace characterization, computable kTypeOfFin, hitOf with mem_hitOf_iff) plus the conditional per-model bridge hit_eq_hitOf_of_presented, a wired evidence probe as B2b's machine-checked verdict, and the B2b successor-record description; 19 hours, 6 waves.

memory_candidates.content: For lean4 plans carrying a `## Lean Challenge Statements` block, avoid `class`/`structure` declarations in the block (the snapshot tool forces every body to `sorry` and a class has no body): state decidability data as explicit instance binders (`[Fintype M.carrier] [DecidableEq M.carrier] [DecidableRel (α := M.carrier) (· < ·)] [∀ p, DecidablePred (M.interp p)]`) and pass finite presentations unbundled (`Q [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q]`, `lab`, `step`) rather than as a structure, so the Goals identifier set equals the Challenge declaration set and signatures pin without a class. Also: when a per-model device's run conditions (HWZ Def 11) are consequences of the realization hypothesis (traces of histories satisfy them by soundness), do not impose them on the finite presentation -- the effective closure then needs no discharge-set bookkeeping.
